guide-intro: WikiJelajah helps you explore places, culture and events from Wikidata on a map, and help complete their data.
guide-explore-text: Choose a region and a category, then click Explore. Results appear as a list in the panel and as markers on the map.
guide-detail-text: Click a name in the list or a marker on the map to read the Wikipedia summary and see photos and other data.
guide-contribute-text: Log in with your Wikimedia account to add missing photos or data, yourself or with the ✨ AI button that looks up values with sources. For many items at once, open Enrich Data from the account menu or the results list.
guide-term-wikidata-def: Wikimedia's open database. All data here comes from it, and your edits are saved to it.
guide-term-item-def: One entry in Wikidata, for example one museum or one beach.
guide-term-qid-def: The unique code of each item, for example Q11477. You usually don't need to type it yourself.
guide-term-attribute-def: A piece of information about an item, for example the year founded or the official website.
explore-intro: Pick a region and a category (places, events, works and more) and see where they are on the map.
results-none-hint: Try another category or a wider region.
enrich-cta-title: Fill in missing data with AI
pk-intro: Fill in missing data for many items at once with the help of AI.
pk-how-1: Choose a region and a category, then load the data to see which attributes are missing.
pk-how-2: Click the cells marked "pick" that you want to look up, then click Search with AI.
pk-how-3: Open the Validation step, check the sources, then approve or reject. Approved values are saved to Wikidata right away.
pk-ai-callout-text: Searches use your own API key (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini or Groq). The key is only stored in this browser.
pk-select-hint: Click "pick" on empty cells, or "select empty" in a column header.
